description: Former Turkish Airlines A310 freighter installed in the grounds of the Oğuzhan Özkaya educational institution at Yelki, Güzelbahçe, and used for teaching. Construction number 480. Independently present in OpenStreetMap as a historic=aircraft node at 38.32607 26.85873. Last updated 12 August 2023.
museum_name: Oğuzhan Özkaya Eğitim Kurumları A310 -- Yelki, İzmir
